orgs: NGC organizations, teams, users, role grants, invitations and the current user (source: ngc_kas)
registry: NGC private registry - org-scoped artifact metadata: models, resources, recipes, helm chart versions, collections, shares, encryption keys (source: ngc_models, org-scoped families)
catalog: NGC public catalog - guest artifact metadata reads plus the GPU and CSP catalogs; the zero-setup surface (source: ngc_models, guest families)
nvcf_functions: NVCF functions, versions, metadata, authorizations (function sharing grants), secrets and rate limits (source: nvcf)
nvcf_deployments: NVCF deployments, GPU specifications, cluster groups and GPUs, registry credentials, telemetries (source: nvcf)
nvcf_queues: NVCF queue details and queue position (source: nvcf)
nvcf_invocation: NVCF HTTP-polling invocation (pexec + status), assets and invocation assertion tokens (source: nvcf)
